title: lean-ordinal-analysis: Verified ε₀ notation and fundamental sequences
description: Executable recursive ordinal notation systems in Lean 4. Version 0.2.0 provides a verified Cantor-normal-form notation system whose canonical terms represent exactly the ordinals below ε₀, together with executable zero/successor/limit classification and certified fundamental sequences for limit notations, including strict monotonicity, boundedness, semantic cofinality, and convergence.
